title: Norm-one conjecture for dominant eigenvectors of non-negative premagic matrices
statement: Let $\mathbf{M}$ be a non-negative premagic matrix, and let $\mathbf{v}$ be an eigenvector corresponding to its dominant eigenvalue. **Norm-one conjecture.** Both the $2$-norm and the Frobenius norm of $\mathbf{v}$ are equal to one. This is presented as a computational conjecture about eigenvectors of non-negative premagic matrices; a mathematical proof is not supplied.
source_name: Kardi Teknomo, “Premagic and Ideal Flow Matrices”, arXiv:1706.08856 (2018).
